entries.title: The one string that survives tool deferral
entries.summary: The MCP `initialize` response now carries an `instructions` string. It did not before: all three transports called `server.create_initialization_options()` bare, so the field went out empty and nothing anywhere said so.

entries.title: Counting each byte of source once
entries.summary: `_savings.json` gains `by_tool`, a lifetime token count per tool, alongside the scalar it has always kept. `get_session_stats` reports it as `lifetime_by_tool`.

entries.title: Charging ourselves for the calls before the one that worked
entries.summary: `analyze_regret` now returns an `inflation` block beside its six cluster signals, and `suggest_corrections` and `digest` surface it. The clusters have always named WHICH queries went wrong; this says what the wrongness cost.
